title: Introduce schema gating with Beta-Schema header and streaming backfill
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: We need a low-risk way to evolve request/response schema behavior for the API surface (streaming, tool-calls, and structured output) while preserving compatibility for existing clients. This PR implements a server-side schema gating mechanism driven by an opt-in Beta header, plus a streaming backfill path that gently converts legacy streaming chunks into the new structured event stream format for clients that opt-in. The change is intended as a backward-compatible rollout: default behavior is unchanged unless the client includes the X-Redwood-Beta-Schema header. The implementation includes a short rollback path and metrics to measure conversion fidelity. Highlights: 1) new header handling middleware (X-Redwood-Beta-Schema: v2-preview) and a graceful gate that routes requests to compatibility adapters; 2) streaming backfill controller that translates legacy "delta/text" chunks into structured stream events and reorders tool/function-calling tokens where safe; 3) adapter layer for OpenAI-compat SDKs to rewrite responses client-side when header present; 4) small changes to evaluator harness and integration tests to validate structured output regressions; 5) docs and changelog entries describing the beta opt-in and recommended migration path. Rollout plan: feature flag on, limited Canary region, monitor conversion_success_rate and client_error_rate for two weeks, then expand to all regions before flipping default. Links: Linear ENG-4123, PM-98. Related: previous schema and fallback work (context: schema negotiation efforts), and streaming stability bugs addressed in PERF tickets. CI: initial lint/test failure on streaming order test; fixed by commit 3. Merge: squash merge after approvals and green CI.

Streaming backfill adapter reduces migration friction by converting legacy chunk format into the v2 event stream on the server when the header is present. Monitor conversion_success_rate and client_error_rate. See docs/migration/beta-schema.md for migration steps.
